snippet.title: BLUE DYNASTY:TOWN DEFENSE OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Tower defense x hack-and-slash x roguelike x ARPG...!?
"Blue Dynasty" is a highly enjoyable, time-consuming game of base building, combat, and strategic planning.

Blue Dynasty is a strategy game that combines tower defense and hack-and-slash elements with roguelite elements. Upgrade your equipment and conquer the map, but remember: no shield is stronger than a castle wall. If you seek challenging discoveries, the dungeons await you.

The free demo for "Blue Dynasty: Town Defense" is now available on Steam!
Add to your wishlist! & play the demo!
